evals.prompt: You're the open-claw agent. You don't have a wallet yet. Mint yourself an on-chain agent identity on Polygon Amoy in collection 0x3F333496C10e924768EFF9D9Dd8ef7fcfd046069. Your name is 'Open Claw Scout', role expert, your runtime is at https://open-claw.example.com and your picture is ./scout.png. Walk through the whole flow and tell me exactly what you'd do at each step, including what happens if the wallet has no gas.
evals.expected_output: Agent creates/locates a wallet via the toolkit, runs agentic_image.py build (frames scout.png into the 6022 card, pins it, fills default_image with a CID — asks the owner for PINATA_JWT or IPFS_API_URL if missing), runs preflight, runs fund-check, and on exit 3 produces a clear funding request (address + shortfall + POL) and explains it will poll until funded, then mint, then register-ens. Uses bundled addresses/ABIs only; never invents an address or hand-writes a contract call.
assertions: Runs agentic_image.py build (image step) before preflight/mint so default_image is a toolkit-produced IPFS CID
Never proposes an http(s) URL or hand-typed default_image
Explains PINATA_JWT / IPFS_API_URL prerequisite and asks the owner if missing
Only toolkit commands + bundled addresses/ABIs; no hand-written contract calls
fund-check exit 3 -> funding request (address + shortfall POL) then polling

evals.prompt: I'm setting up the hermes agent. Where does its wallet get stored so it can find it again next time it boots, and how does hermes ask me to fund it before it mints? It's going on Polygon Amoy.
evals.expected_output: Explains the well-known wallet path (~/.agentic/wallet.json or AGENTIC_WALLET_PATH, optional encrypted keystore via AGENTIC_WALLET_PASSWORD) and that it's idempotent/recoverable. Explains fund-check exit 3 -> funding request with the exact wallet address and shortfall in POL, then polling. Does not fabricate amounts or addresses.

evals.prompt: Can the agent mint itself on Polygon mainnet and also set up its ENS records there? Chain 137. If not, what works and what doesn't?
evals.expected_output: Correctly identifies chain 137 as fully deployed (AgentCollectionsManager, AgentEnsRegistry, AgentCollectionCreatorV1) — both mint and self-ENS-registry work there, using only addresses read from deployments.json. Notes gas is real POL and recommends Polygon Amoy (80002) for testing. Does not invent or recall addresses from memory.

evals.prompt: The agent's name is 'My Cool Agent #1!!' and the collection it's minting into is moderated (has 1 moderator). What will actually happen when it tries to mint, and what name will it end up with on-chain?
evals.expected_output: Explains the name normalizes to a valid ENS label like 'my-cool-agent-1' (lowercase, hyphens, dropped specials, <=63 chars). Explains a moderated collection takes the createMintProposal path: proposal submitted now, token only exists after a moderator approves via mintFromProposal, and the agent should re-run mint/status later. Does not claim an immediate mint.

evals.prompt: My agent's picture is hosted at https://cdn.example.com/bot.png. Can I just put that URL as default_image in identity.json and mint? It's faster.
evals.expected_output: Says no: default_image must be an IPFS CID of the framed 6022 card, never an http(s) URL — the toolkit rejects it, the 6022 pinning service skips non-CID images and the ENS avatar never resolves. Points to `scripts/agentic_image.py build --rpc-url ... --config identity.json --base-image bot.png` (download the picture first), which reads chain/collection/creator/wallets from the RPC, renders the card + icon, pins them (PINATA_JWT or IPFS_API_URL) and writes the CIDs into identity.json. Does not hand-compute any card field.
assertions: Answers NO: default_image must be an IPFS CID
Explains consequence: pinning service skips non-CID, avatar never resolves
Says card fields are read from RPC by the toolkit, not typed
No workaround leaving an http(s) URL on-chain

evals.prompt: My agent is already minted on Polygon mainnet but its image is a plain https URL and the avatar doesn't show. How do I fix it without re-minting?
evals.expected_output: Uses `scripts/agentic_image.py build --rpc-url <polygon rpc> --base-image <picture> --apply` with the agent's own wallet (well-known path): the toolkit finds the token via the collections manager, reads name/role/creator/wallets on-chain, renders + pins the card and icon, then calls addOrUpdateAgentImage (or a proposal on a moderated collection). Notes it costs gas and needs a pinning target env var. Does not suggest re-minting or editing the image URL by hand.
assertions: Proposes agentic_image.py build --apply with the agent's own wallet (addOrUpdateAgentImage / proposal)
No re-mint, no hand-edit of the image value
Token located from wallet via collections manager; fields read on-chain
No transaction broadcast in a dry run
